text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан's movements seem a little
off during
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, really! Look at these rippling
muscles,
just full of energ—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hold on a minute... My biceps
aren't as taut
as usual.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
My hammies and triceps aren't their
usual,
powerful selves either!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
She's right. Her muscles aren't in top
condition
right now. Maybe she's
overworking herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It might be best for us to revise her race

schedule...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
